about: External references for lox and loxone-config. Links only: the documents stay with their publishers (Loxone's PDFs carry no license to redistribute). tools/fetch-refs.py downloads them into refs/ (gitignored) and checks the pinned sha256 of every 'pinned' entry; a mismatch means the publisher changed the file: re-read it, then update the pin (--update). Facts taken from a reference go into our docs in our own words, citing the entry's id and section.
